Dish.meta_description: Chicken 65 at Tikka N Kabab, 7859 McCallum Blvd, Dallas TX 75252 near UTD. Open daily 11 AM-9:30 PM. Order online or call (469) 857-3000.
Dish.page_copy:
Looking for chicken 65 near me? Chicken 65 is a spicy, crispy fried chicken appetizer, and one of the best-value plates on our menu at $9.99.

Tikka N Kabab is at 7859 McCallum Blvd Ste 106, Dallas, TX 75252. We are open every day from 11 AM to 9:30 PM, and you can call us at (469) 857-3000 to place an order or ask a question before you come in.

Our menu includes appetizers like Chicken Samosa and Beef Samosa ($3.99 for 2), Veg Samosa, Onion Bhajji (Pakoda), Dal Puri and Chicken 65 ($9.99); curries like Butter Chicken, Chicken Tikka Masala, Chicken Kadahi and Chicken Keema ($12.99 each), Beef Nihari and Shrimp Masala ($14.99); plus Lahori Fish, Gobhi Manchurian, biryani, BBQ/grill, wraps, chaat, naan and paratha, dessert and drinks. Every item is cooked to order in our kitchen, so it reaches you hot and crisp. If you are new to this food, start with a plate of samosas and add Chicken 65 if you like heat; if you prefer something milder, Dal Puri and Veg Samosa are good choices.

Many of our guests come from the neighborhoods around McCallum Blvd, Campbell Rd and Coit Rd, from Richardson, and from the UT Dallas campus about two miles away. It is easy to stop by for a snack, pick up food for a group, or sit down for a simple meal with friends or family.

Google reviewers currently rate Tikka N Kabab 4.2 stars across more than 400 reviews. We read every review and use the feedback to keep improving our food and service. If you visit, we would be grateful for an honest review that mentions what you ordered, because it helps other people nearby find dishes they will enjoy.

Before you visit, check our Google Business Profile for photos of the food and the latest posts. Menu prices shown here can change; please call to confirm. Full menu and online ordering: https://www.tikkankababtx.com. [Owner: add halal status and catering details here only once confirmed.]

Come by Tikka N Kabab today for chicken 65 and the rest of our menu. We look forward to cooking for you.
